name: amdrome
title: amdrome — Intelligent Industry factory challenge
description: Discrete-manufacturing factory simulation: layout, labour, kanban monitoring under partial observability, and shared-market bidding. Anti-tape by design: per-episode hyperprior draws, no canonical opponent pool.

agents.name: operator

actions.bids: {contract_id: price} — sealed bids on open contracts

agents.observation: kanban-only: station cards, CUSUM state, WIP count, spot price, open contracts, last-tick results. Ground truth (wear, defect status) never exposed.

configuration.score: net_profit = contract revenue - late/escape penalties - input - PM/breakdown/scrap/downtime costs
